replication.target_description: Replication section 3.2, printed p.946 (PDF p.4): reaction times in emotion and gender discrimination, AN versus healthy controls. The locator does not distinguish TASK, EMOTION, TASK-by-EMOTION, GROUP, or the group interactions.

notes: Reaction-time results contain several ANOVA terms. The main group effect and group interactions are reported collectively as Fs < 1; there is no individually identified F or corresponding p for the requested target. No term selected arbitrarily. The authors’ overall emotion-recognition replication verdict was not substituted for a target-specific verdict on this response-time, control-task, or unidentified misclassification test. Replication contains AN and healthy-control groups, not a separate major-depression group. The original dissertation was retained separately as non-article provenance; original terminal miss records acquisition routes.
